title: Can occupational therapy help my autistic child who feels uncomfortable with certain textures?
metaTitle: Occupational Therapy for Sensory Issues | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Pinnacle Blooms Network's expert therapists help children with autism overcome sensory issues, including discomfort with certain textures, using specialized approaches.
html: Absolutely! Sensory issues, including discomfort with certain textures, are quite common in children with autism. Our occupational therapists are well-equipped in sensory integration strategies. They support your child to gradually become more comfortable with different textures in an environment that respects their needs and feelings. This process helps to reduce their hypersensitivity over time, adding to their overall comfort and enriching their interaction with their surroundings.
